g.text: Cross-category similarity and SDS with in-category references
Alphabets 2 and 3 · H=5 · Matched axes per alphabet across Figures 3–8
Points are means within similarity bins of width 0.05; empty bins break lines. Equivalent pairs excluded.
Hollow points / faint dotted segments: fewer than 30 pairs. Grey: in-category 10/20/30-state curves.
